interpretation: Frozen local subsets, three attempts per agent and task. Rank matched tasks only, with equal domain weights. Report native benchmark submetrics separately from tool schema validity; semantic correctness requires task-specific evidence. Direct ChatGPT subscription, GPT-6.1 Sol/high, Fast requested as priority. Returned tiers are recorded without claiming confirmed served Fast. The shared judge adapter proportionally fits oversized images within the subscription endpoint's 30,000-patch input limit and audits transformations. Candidate tokens, latency and inference counts exclude judging. The two API-leakage Safety tasks use documented immutable-initial-fixture validation repairs, identically for every agent. This is a modified local benchmark subset, rather than an unmodified official leaderboard score.
publication_status: Preliminary WildClawBench ranking on valid matched tasks across all six domains. Unresolved fixture, capability, task-guide, and grading exclusions remain; results are not a certified final leaderboard. PinchBench and Terminal-Bench are not yet scored.
